questions.question: In an acidic medium, 10 mL of 0.25 M oxalic acid is titrated with $\mathrm{KMnO}_4$ solution. If the volume of $\mathrm{KMnO}_4$ solution required to reach end point is 10 mL , the strength of the $\mathrm{KMnO}_4$ solution is
questions.explanation:
$\mathrm{KMnO}_4+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{C}_2 \mathrm{O}_4 \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H}^{+}} \mathrm{Mn}^{2+}+2 \mathrm{CO}_2+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$

No. of equivalent of $\mathrm{KMnO}_4=\mathrm{No}$. of equivalent of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{C}_2 \mathrm{O}_4$

\[\begin{aligned} & 10 \times 5 \times M=10 \times 0.25 \times 2 \\ & M=\frac{5}{50} \\ & M=\frac{1}{10}=0.10 M \end{aligned}\]

questions.question: Oxidation numbers of P in PO\(_4^{3 - }\), of S in SO\(_4^{2 - }\) and that of Cr in Cr<sub>2</sub>O\(_7^{2 - }\) are respectively
questions.explanation:
Let oxidation number of P in PO4 3– be x.

\(\therefore\) x + 4(–2) = –3

\(\Rightarrow\) x = +5

Let oxidation number of S in SO4 2– be y.

\(\therefore\) y + 4(–2) = –2

\(\Rightarrow\) y = +6

Let oxidation number of Cr in Cr2O7 2– be z.

\(\Rightarrow\) 2z + 7(–2) = –2

\(\Rightarrow\) z = +6

questions.question: Number of moles of MnO\(_4^{ - }\) required to oxidize one mole of ferrous oxalate completely in acidic medium will be
questions.explanation:
The balanced ionic equation for oxidation of ferrous oxalate by MnO4– in acidic medium is as follows :

3MnO4- + 5FeC2O4 + 24H+ \(\to\)

3Mn2+ + 10CO2 + 12H2O + 5Fe3+

Thus, 5 moles of FeC2O4 require 3 moles of MnO4-.

So, 1 mole of FeC2O4 requires

= \({3 \over 5}\) = 0.6 moles of MnO4-

questions.question:
Which is the best description of the behaviour of bromine in the reaction given below?
H2O + Br2 \(\to\) HOBr + HBr
questions.explanation:
H2O + \({\mathop {Br}\limits^0}\)2 \(\to\) HO\(\mathop {Br}\limits^{ + 1}\) + H\(\mathop {Br}\limits^{ - 1}\)

In the above reaction the oxidation number of Br2 increases from zero (in Br2 ) to +1 (in HOBr) and decreases from zero (in Br2 ) to –1 (in HBr). Thus Br2 is oxidised as well as reduced and hence it is a redox reaction.
